  • Your keys stay on this phone. They are encrypted with your PIN. No server, no sign-up.
  • A kill switch for your bots. This phone gets an emergency key. Add it to your bot accounts as a signer from your PC, then Cancel Orders or Cancel + Close Positions from here.
  • Starts on Testnet. Practise with free test coins, then switch to Mainnet in Settings.

Settings

Network
Server ·
Stop orders
Your stop server watches the price every second and sends your signed stop orders. It never gets your keys.
Price guard
A stop never fills more than this much worse than the Coinbase, Kraken and Binance average. Protects you if someone empties Stellar's order book to grab stops. It waits instead.
Kill switch key (this phone)
On the PC run Add-Emergency-Signer.bat and paste this address. Lost phone: run Remove-Emergency-Signer.bat.
Wallets with keys on this phone
Watched wallets ()
Wallets you watch by address, like bots your PC runs. No key here. Saved on this device only.
Buy / sell and gain / loss colors
Order book, last sales, Activity and P/L gains / losses. The Trade screen's Buy / Sell buttons keep their own colors.
Swap slippage cap
If the price moves more than this before your swap goes through, nothing trades.
Close positions into
What Cancel + Close Positions turns XLM and stablecoins into: your "flat" currency.
Trade slippage cap
Market orders on Trade, and Cancel + Close Positions (kill switch).
Testnet practice
Makes fake test bots on Testnet (a trader holding XLM and USDC with open orders, a market maker with quotes) with this phone as signer, plus a test USDC market, so you can practise Cancel Orders and Cancel + Close Positions. Testnet coins are free and worthless.
